_doc: The Creation Artifact (see docs/DESIGN.md). starting_lives: lives a new character has. max_lives: cap on stored lives. anchor_slots: realm id -> anchors that can be bound once the player reaches that realm (the highest reached realm listed applies). start_anchor: anchor id bound automatically for a new character. recharge: buying a life costs round(base_cost * cost_growth ^ lives bought so far) spirit stones. respawn: on a violent death with a life left, the player respawns at their most recently bound anchor (the start region if none; the respawn screen then lets them awaken at any other bound anchor instead), losing qi_loss_fraction of current qi while days pass. Anchors are places in data/regions.json with an 'anchor_id' (globally unique). energy (ART-002): feeding the artifact gives stone_energy per spirit stone, and floor(price * item_energy_per_price) per other item (price-0 items cannot be fed); energy is capped at max_energy and spent to unlock functions. functions: sealed powers the player unlocks (ArtifactFunctions): {id (must be a function the code implements: storage, appraisal), name, description, flavor (optional, ART-006c: what the artifact says when this seal breaks; keep its maker and origin vague), unlock: {realm (optional realm id reached), energy (spent on unlocking), flag (optional world flag that must be set), function (optional function id that must be unsealed first)}, plus per-function fields: storage has storage_slots (distinct item stacks the storage space holds), inner_world (ART-003b) has qi_density (cultivation density inside), dilation (inner days per world day; the body ages by the inner days) and max_days (world days per entry), spirit_garden (ART-004) has plots (herbs growing at once) and plants {item id: {days, yield: [min, max]}}: plant one of a carried herb, wait `days` of inner time (world days x the inner world's dilation), harvest yield copies; its unlock also takes function (another function that must be unsealed first), appraisal has talent_tiers [{min_multiplier (of SpiritualRoots.cultivation_multiplier), name}] in rising order, the highest matching tier naming a character's talent}. intro_event (optional, ART-006b): a dialogue id (data/dialogue/, not bound to an NPC; nodes set their own speaker) played once when a new character starts; loaded saves never play it.

functions.name: Storage Space
functions.description: A pocket of folded space opens inside the artifact. Whatever you keep there stays with your soul, even through death.
functions.flavor: The artifact stirs against your chest. "A pocket of nothing, folded small. Once whole armouries slept in it. Now it holds your pills. Well. Everyone starts somewhere."

functions.name: Appraising Eye
functions.description: A cold eye opens behind your own. Spiritual roots, talent, the years left to a person and the true grade of a treasure are laid bare to you.
functions.flavor: A cold voice seems to look out through your eyes. "Roots, years, the grade of a blade... I have weighed greater things than these. Look closely, mortal. Most of what you meet is less than it seems."

functions.name: Inner World
functions.description: A small world unfolds inside the artifact: a valley of thick qi under a sky that is not the sky. Time runs faster there, and the body ages with it.
functions.flavor: For a heartbeat you stand under a sky that is not the sky. "This was a garden once, and then a prison, and then nothing at all. Breathe it in slowly. It remembers being bigger."

functions.name: Spirit Garden
functions.description: Terraces of black soil appear in the inner world's valley. Herbs planted there drink its thick qi and its quickened time.
functions.flavor: Black soil turns over in the valley inside the artifact. "Plant, wait, harvest. Even the old powers had to eat. Do not ask what grew here before."
